title: 第二十章 从没对他做过
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
萧姚看看99的黑化值，又看看秦弦如临大敌的模样，再看看被扣了20天的倒计时，陷入了沉思。

    她好像也没干什么吧。

    她不就是不小心拿出了点不太正经的东西，显得好像玩得很花，从纨绔变成了变态。

    黑化值这就爆表了？

    生活不易，萧姚叹气。

    出师不利，这可咋整啊……

    要不先撤，等秦弦不那么应激了再来？

    萧姚不敢轻举妄动，生怕再刺激到秦弦，彻底完蛋，然而邵馆主可不想就这么放过大主顾。

    他用法器隔绝出一个不被窥探的私密空间，就地安置萧姚三人，招牌酒菜一摆，开始跟萧姚客套拉关系。

    直到酒过三巡菜过五味，邵馆主才意犹未尽地收起话头，客气地引着萧姚去了顶层。

    顶层的环境和下边的乌烟瘴气截然不同。仙气飘飘，琴音袅袅，连香味都清雅起来。

    萧姚一直垮着的脸色终于缓和了些。

    邵馆主的狐狸眼中灵光一闪。

    果然，名声在外的纨绔，总是好些面子，喜欢用人皮来遮掩自己的兽心，彰显自己的不俗。

    这不，满意了。

    邵馆主脸上的笑意又深了几分，他先将程宛君请进头一间屋子，又在第二间屋门口站定，故作纠结地开口询问：

    “萧大小姐，秦公子已恭候您多时，您请。”

    “只是这位……道友，敢问大小姐想如何安置？可需要小人安排佳人作伴，还是……？”

    寻欢作乐的纨绔他见多了，但是带着男人找男人的，他还真是头一次见。

    刚才看两人的站位，这半妖大概是萧姚的侍从？但两人之间不自觉流露出的亲近，又让他不能不多想。

    萧姚也觉得带着小朋友出入这种场合不太合适，于是回头用眼神询问苍岚。

    苍岚一言不发，只是用狼尾缠上萧姚的手腕，狼耳不适地下压，神情有些忐忑。

    萧姚在心里叹了口气，安抚性地拍拍他的尾巴。

    “这里人多，他人生地不熟，独自一人指不定会碰到不长眼的渣滓。他跟我一起，馆主自便。”

    邵馆主笑着告辞，转过身后，若有所思。

    这两人的关系……有点意思，从这半妖身上入手，没准能榨出更多东西。

    ……

    萧姚任由苍岚缠着，带着他一起推门而入。

    米色的帷幔层层叠叠，颜色渐变成粉。香风越来越浓，连内间的空气都好似比外边闷热。

    掀开最后一层帷幔，内室的景象终于露出庐山真面目。

    极具冲击力的美景瞬间撞入眼帘，萧姚只觉得呼吸一顿，心里写满卧槽。
content_en:
Xiao Yao looked at the blackening value of 99, then looked at Qin Xian's appearance as if facing a formidable enemy, and then looked at the 20-day countdown, and fell into deep thought.

It seems like she didn't do anything.

Didn't she just accidentally take out something that was not serious? She seemed to be having a lot of fun and turned from a playboy to a pervert.

Is the blackening value going off the charts?

Life is not easy, Xiao Yao sighed.

It's a bad start, how can we deal with this...

How about withdrawing first and coming back when Qin Xian is less stressed?

Xiao Yao didn't dare to act rashly, for fear of irritating Qin Xian again and being completely ruined. However, the owner of the restaurant, Shao, didn't want to let his big patron go just like that.

He used a magic weapon to isolate a private space from prying eyes, settled Xiao Yao and the others on the spot, laid out his signature wine and food, and began to cultivate relations with Xiao Yao politely.

It wasn't until after three rounds of wine and five delicious dishes that the owner of the restaurant, Shao, stopped talking and politely led Xiao Yao to the top floor.

The environment on the top floor is completely different from the smoky atmosphere below.The fairy spirit floats in the air, the sound of the piano curls up, and even the fragrance becomes elegant.

Xiao Yao's downcast expression finally softened.

Master Shao's fox eyes flashed with inspiration.

Sure enough, a well-known dandy always has a good reputation and likes to use human skin to cover up his beastly heart and show off his excellence.

No, I'm satisfied.

The smile on Master Shao's face deepened a little deeper. He first invited Cheng Wanjun into the first room, and then stopped at the door of the second room, pretending to be hesitant and asking:

"Miss Xiao, Mr. Qin has been waiting for you for a long time. Please come."

"It's just this... fellow Taoist, may I ask how the eldest lady wants to arrange it? Does it need a villain to arrange for a beautiful woman to accompany her, or...?"

He had seen a lot of dandy looking for fun, but this was the first time he had seen a man looking for a man.

Looking at the positions of the two of them just now, this half-demon is probably Xiao Yao's attendant?But the unconscious intimacy between the two made him think more about it.

Xiao Yao also felt that it was not appropriate to bring a child to such an occasion, so he turned around and asked Cang Lan with his eyes.

Cang Lan didn't say a word, just wrapped the wolf's tail around Xiao Yao's wrist, her wolf ears pressed down uncomfortably, and she looked a little uneasy.

Xiao Yao sighed inwardly and patted his tail comfortingly.

"There are a lot of people here, and he is not familiar with the place. If he is alone, he might encounter some unsighted scum. He is coming with me, and the owner can do what he wants."

Master Shao said goodbye with a smile and turned around, thoughtfully.

The relationship between these two people is... a bit interesting. Starting from this half-demon, we might be able to squeeze out more things.

…

Xiao Yao allowed Cang Lan to pester him and pushed the door open with him.

The beige curtains are layered in layers and fade into pink.The fragrance is getting stronger and stronger, and even the air inside seems to be muggier than outside.

The last layer of curtains was lifted, and the scene in the inner room finally revealed the true face of Mount Lu.

The impactful beautiful scenery suddenly hit his eyes. Xiao Yao just felt like he took a breath, and his heart was full of shit.
title_en: Chapter 20 Never did it to him
